blurb:
This exclusive 3.5-hour Golden Age of Hollywood tour focuses on classic film icons like Crawford and Davis, rather than contemporary figures such as Bieber and Kardashian. It offers an exceptional overview of the landmarks in Hollywood and Beverly Hills, with particular attention to the stars, studios, and history from a bygone era that significantly contributed to the prominence of Los Angeles. Rest assured, your private guide is an experienced industry professional.
